name: search_ncr_history
description: Search the Non-Conformity Report knowledge base (past NCR history). Returns a JSON list of similar reports with ref, source, modality (text or image), score and summary. Call this BEFORE proposing a procedure so the proposal can cite similar past cases.

query.description: Short description of the situation, e.g. 'P-101 pump seal leak'.

top_k.description: How many similar reports to retrieve (1-10, default 5).
